game.name: Rapala Tournament Fishing (USA)
game.desc: Rapala Tournament Fishing on Xbox 360 is an angling simulation. Here you will find a high quality and very complete equipment that you must assemble in order to catch the coveted scorpion fish. You will also need the legendary weapon of the perfect little fisherman: patience. It's up to you to make the right choice in your instruments and to choose the right spot if you want to bring home something to eat!
